scripts.openapi:generate: dotnet run --project ../src/Lumio.Platform.App -c Release -- openapi-export src/Lumio.Platform.App/openapi/v1.json && openapi-typescript ../src/Lumio.Platform.App/openapi/v1.json -o src/api/schema.d.ts
scripts.openapi:check: npm run openapi:generate && git diff --exit-code -- ../src/Lumio.Platform.App/openapi/v1.json src/api/schema.d.ts
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run openapi:check
